title: Build a metric tree
summary: A metric tree breaks your top metric into the drivers and inputs that move it. It shows which levers your team can pull and how your work links to the goal.

beginner: Start with your top metric, such as your north star.
Break it into two to four drivers that add up to it.
Break each driver into inputs a team can change.
Mark which inputs your team owns.
Use the tree to explain why your work matters.
intermediate: Check the maths: drivers should add up to the top metric.
Agree one definition for each metric with data teams.
Use the tree to find where a drop started.
experienced: Build a shared tree across teams to link work to company goals.
Use it to spot under-invested drivers in planning.
Keep it up to date as the business changes.

toolExamples.miro: Draw the tree on a board.
toolExamples.mixpanel: Build the tree from live metrics.
toolExamples.amplitude: Link each input to a chart.

pitfalls: Drawing it once and never using it
